permissions.noManage: Cleaning up map chunks requires the chunks.manage permission, which this role doesn't have.

permissionDenied.title: You can't view Map Cleanup
permissionDenied.description: Your account's role doesn't include "Manage map chunks". Ask an administrator to grant it if you need access to this page.

pageHeader.title: Map Cleanup
pageHeader.description: Reset damaged or over-looted map areas so the world can regenerate cleanly
pageHeader.warning: Deleting chunks resets those areas — constructions, loot, and zombies will be lost. Stop the server first and keep backups enabled.

save.title: Save
save.customPathPlaceholder: Path to the Zomboid data folder
save.customPathHint: Point at your Zomboid data folder, a <1>Saves/Multiplayer</1> folder, or a single save directory.
save.customPathHintWindows: Point at your Zomboid data folder, a <1>Saves/Multiplayer</1> folder, or a single save directory. Windows variables such as <3>%USERPROFILE%</3> are expanded.
save.customPathHintPosix: Point at your Zomboid data folder, a <1>Saves/Multiplayer</1> folder, or a single save directory. <2>~</2>, <4>$HOME</4>, and ${NAME} variables are expanded.
save.saveAsDefaultTitle: Make this the panel's default Zomboid data folder so you don't have to re-enter it.
save.autoDetected: Auto-detected this folder. Save it as the default?

tools.selectAllTip: "All" selects every chunk this save has ever generated, not just the ones visible on screen right now. Deleting that selection resets the entire map.

canvas.selectSaveDesc: Choose a save from the panel to review chunk data.
canvas.noSavesDesc: The panel couldn't list any saves with the current data path.
canvas.installFolderHint: Looks like a server install folder — point at the user data folder instead.
canvas.titleFolderMissing: Folder does not exist on this host
canvas.howToFind: How to find your data folder
canvas.mustContain: It must contain a <1>Saves/Multiplayer/</1> subfolder once the server has been started at least once.
canvas.pointDirect: You can also point directly at a single save folder (e.g. <1>.../Saves/Multiplayer/MyServer</1>).
canvas.noChunksDesc: This save's map folder may be empty, or the configured path needs adjusting. Try a different save from the list above, or check the path in Settings.
canvas.ariaLabel: Chunk map. Selecting areas to clean up requires a mouse or touchscreen; this map is not keyboard-operable.

help.selectDesc: Click or drag to select. Hold Shift to deselect.
help.navigateDesc: Scroll to zoom, right-click to pan. Press 1/2 to switch tools.
help.deleteDesc: Rebuilds those areas on next visit. Press Delete or use the button.
help.shortcutsDesc: Esc clears selection. Backup stays enabled by default.

deleteDialog.description_one: This permanently removes {{count}} chunk file ({{size}}). When players revisit that area, the game rebuilds it and removes any player-built structures or stored items there.
deleteDialog.description_other: This permanently removes {{count}} chunk files ({{size}}). When players revisit those areas, the game rebuilds them and removes any player-built structures or stored items there.
deleteDialog.backupDesc: Save a copy of the selected chunks before deleting them.
deleteDialog.noBackupDesc: You will not be able to recover these chunks after deletion.
deleteDialog.removeVehiclesLoaded_one: {{count}} vehicle currently loaded in this area.
deleteDialog.removeVehiclesLoaded_other: {{count}} vehicles currently loaded in this area.
deleteDialog.removeVehiclesUnloaded: Unloaded vehicles still live in vehicles.db and respawn when a player revisits.
deleteDialog.removeVehiclesDetail: Deletes matching rows from vehicles.db so cars don't come back.
deleteDialog.safehouseOverlapSuffix: — structures will be lost when chunks regenerate.

serverRunningDialog.title: Server appears to be running
serverRunningDialog.description: The panel detected processes that look like a Project Zomboid dedicated server. Deleting chunks while the server is live will corrupt the save when it writes back on shutdown.
serverRunningDialog.noMatchInfo: No matched process info was returned, but the detector reported the server as running.
serverRunningDialog.overrideWarningTitle: Only override if you are sure
serverRunningDialog.overrideWarningDesc: If you stopped the server with a custom systemd unit / launcher we don't recognise, or one of the processes above is unrelated (e.g. a different Java app), you can force the delete. Otherwise, stop the server first.

toasts.liveVehicleCleanupNoPermissionDesc: Chunks and their vehicle records were deleted. Removing already-loaded vehicles from the live server needs the bridge.command permission, which this role doesn't have -- an admin can grant it, or a stale vehicle will disappear on its own next time the area reloads.
toasts.liveVehicleCleanupTooFragmentedDesc: Chunks and their vehicle records were deleted. This selection was too scattered to sync live vehicles for -- a stale vehicle will disappear on its own next time the area reloads.
toasts.pathSavedServerDesc: Saved to the active server config — the panel will use this path next time.
toasts.chunksDeletedPartialTitle: Some Chunks Could Not Be Deleted
toasts.chunksDeletedPartialDesc_one: Removed {{deleted}} chunk, but {{count}} failed. Check the file isn't locked by another process and try again.
toasts.chunksDeletedPartialDesc_other: Removed {{deleted}} chunks, but {{count}} failed. Check the files aren't locked by another process and try again.
toasts.activeServerChangedDesc: The active server changed while chunks were loaded. The scan was cleared -- pick a save again before deleting.
